breakdown.description: Stokes (creeping-flow) drag is applied at a Reynolds number that is not in the creeping-flow regime.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification directly repeats the Stokes drag formula Fd = 3 * pi * mu * D * V without any correction. It does not compute the Reynolds number, does not flag that Re is far from the creeping-flow regime (Re ≈ 2500 >> 1), and does not switch to an appropriate drag-coefficient correlation (Cd(Re) with Fd = (1/2) rho V^2 Cd A) as the ground truth requires.
